subtitle: Work the agent does over time, grouped by category.
info: A project is a deliverable, a recurring job or a standing duty. Drag a card to another category (or use Move to… on a touch screen); the move can be undone.
noMatchBody: Try a different search, or clear the filters to see every project.
emptyBody: Anything the agent works on over time — a deliverable, a recurring job, a standing duty — lives here. Create one, let the agent draft its plan, and run it from this app.

wizard.infoLabel: How does a new project work?
wizard.info: Four short steps: the goal, what it delivers, how it runs, then a review. You can go back to any finished step before you create it.
wizard.outputsInfo: Each output is one thing the project hands over — a report, a file, a message. The agent plans its work around them and asks you to accept each one.
wizard.subtitle: Four short steps; nothing is created until you review it.
wizard.discardBody: Your answers haven't been saved. Leaving now throws them away.
